output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # non-background color used as ruling lines
    cnt=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r if x!=bg)
    line=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr=sum(1 for r in grid if all(x==line for x in r))
    vc=sum(1 for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c]==line for r in range(h)))
    return [[bg]*(vc+1) for _ in range(hr+1)]"}
